comps.label: C1
comps.reason: Regulated gas and electric utility and propane distributor; it delivers energy rather than producing gas from wells.

comps.label: C2
comps.reason: Regulated New York utility delivering electricity, gas and steam over its networks; no upstream production or power plant ownership.

comps.label: C3
comps.reason: Reservoir analysis, lab testing and perforating services sold to operators; BKV is a producer and seller of gas and power.

comps.label: C4
comps.reason: Residential and commercial propane distribution with appliance service; a different product and customer base from BKV's gas production.

comps.label: C5
comps.reason: Artificial lift equipment rental and field services for operators; BKV sells its own gas and power rather than providing well equipment.

comps.label: C6
comps.reason: Coal mining and coal-fired power sold to utilities; shares a power plant model but the fuel and mining business differs from BKV's gas.

comps.label: C7
comps.reason: Permian gas gathering, processing and produced water handling for producers, with liquids sales; closely mirrors BKV's gathering and water services.

comps.label: C8
comps.reason: Compressor rental and fabrication for producers; equipment business rather than gas production, gathering or power sales.

comps.label: C9
comps.reason: Crude oil refining with retail fuel stations and wholesale fuels; a downstream refining business unlike BKV's upstream gas production.

comps.label: C10
comps.reason: Frac sand mining and logistics sold to well completion companies; supplies a completion input, not natural gas or power.

comps.label: C11
comps.reason: Rented mobile turbine power and sand handling equipment under contract; equipment rental model differs from BKV's owned gas production.

comps.label: C12
comps.reason: Residential propane and heating oil delivery to households through branches; a retail fuel distribution business unlike BKV.

comps.label: C13
comps.reason: Global oilfield drilling and well services with field crews; a service business rather than a gas producer selling gas and power.
